title: THE LINE-SCATTER DECOMPOSITION: the 12-decade line's 0.18-dex residual -- freeze-epoch vs systematics vs channel
question: what orders the perpendicular scatter of the 12-decade line (b = 1.004 +- 0.011, rms 0.180, n = 542): (a) the freeze-epoch z* (G213: never-froze dSphs scatter differently); (b) the channel (G128 rotation vs dispersion); (c) the per-object systematics (G087-type proxies)
method: per-object |r| = |log10(obs/pred)| regressed on the candidate axes; z* per object from sigma_eq (pred for dispersion channels, v_pred/sqrt(2) for rotation channels), z*+1 = m sigma^2/(k_B T0), m = 5 keV/c^2, T0 = 2.72548 K; freeze floor 65.0 km/s @ 5 keV (60.9 @ 5.7)

V1.statement: THE VARIANCE DECOMPOSITION of |r| (n = 542): (a) the FREEZE axis alone explains R^2 = 0.084 (Spearman rho = -0.096, p = 2.52e-02); the frozen/unfrozen BINARY alone R^2 = 0.068; (b) the CHANNEL factor alone eta^2 = 0.227 (rot/disp binary eta^2 = 0.020); (c) the ISOLATED freeze contribution net of the channel = 0.017 (R^2(channel+z*) - R^2(channel)); the isolated channel net of the freeze = 0.161 (R^2(channel+z*) - R^2(z*)).  WITHIN the dSph class the freeze depth orders the scatter: rho = -0.691, p = 6.1e-06 (G213's -0.691 reproduced).  The per-object systematics: RAW inside the dSphs they correlate with |r| (e_MV rho = +0.60, e_sig rho = +0.47) but the correlations COLLAPSE net of the freeze axis (R^2 net-of-freeze: e_MV 0.073, e_sig 0.000) and are negligible inside SPARC (G087's registered LOOCV R^2 = 0.030) -- the proxy signal rides the same faint-end/freeze-depth gradient, it is not an independent term.

V2.statement: THE FROZEN-DOMAIN LINE (z* > 0 only, n = 323): slope b = 1.155 +- 0.029 ((b-1)/se = +5.35 -- TILTED, see the note), rms about identity 0.140 dex (full line: b = 1.004 +- 0.011, rms 0.179 dex, n = 542); median |r| 0.091.  THE DOMAIN SHARPENS: rms 0.179 -> 0.140 dex when only the frozen systems count, and the one-sided departure vanishes (median r +0.081, the unfrozen median r +0.050).  THE PRICE OF THE SHARPENING: the frozen line's slope is 1.155 +- 0.029, NOT 1 -- the frozen domain contains the registered normalization RISE across mass (ATLAS3D's own internal slope 1.30 +- 0.05 with residual drift +0.074/dex, the GEMS +0.115 -> cluster +0.273 seam), so the 0.18-dex full-line slope 1.004 is a BLEND of the two ends.  Complementary cuts: the dispersion-face frozen population (GRP+A3D+CL, n = 306) rms 0.143 slope 1.154; G213's registered alternative domain (sigma_pred >= 2.1 km/s, n = 533) rms 0.168 slope 1.029; the never-froze population (n = 219) rms 0.225 slope 0.917 -- the scatter's excess lives there, one-sided (median r +0.050).
V2.slope_tilt_note: the frozen domain's slope %.3f > 1 ((b-1)/se = %+.2f) is the registered normalization rise inside it -- ATLAS3D internal slope 1.30 +- 0.05 (G162), the group +0.115 -> cluster +0.273 seam (G162 V2, G131 SPLIT 2): the frozen domain is TIGHT but TILTED.

V3.statement: HONEST: the 12-decade line's 0.18-dex perpendicular scatter is ordered by TWO axes that are confounded at the class level -- the freeze-epoch and the channel.  (1) THE FREEZE-EPOCH IS THE ORDERING AXIS FOR THE DISPERSION DEPARTURES: within the dSph class the excess correlates with the freeze depth (rho = -0.691, p = 6.1e-06, R^2 = 0.066; G213 reproduced), and the UFD shell alone carries 19% of the pooled |r|^2; the never-froze population's excess is one-sided (median r +0.050) while the frozen population's is a zero point (median r +0.081, rms 0.140 -- slope 1.155, inside it the registered cluster normalization gap +0.27 dex, tight).  (2) THE CHANNEL IS THE OTHER MAIN TERM: eta^2 = 0.227 of |r| lives between channels (rotation 0.08-0.12, dispersion/boundary 0.16-0.18, UFD 0.40), and the ISOLATED freeze contribution NET of the channel is 0.017 -- the two axes share most of their variance because the never-froze classes ARE the low-sigma dispersion classes.  (3) THE PER-OBJECT SYSTEMATICS ARE NOT AN INDEPENDENT TERM: inside the dSphs the error proxies DO correlate with |r| RAW (e_MV rho = +0.60, e_sig rho = +0.47 -- fainter UFDs have bigger errors AND the bigger excess) but the correlation COLLAPSES net of the freeze axis (R^2 net-of-freeze: e_MV 0.073, e_sig 0.000) and is negligible inside the well-measured channels (SPARC errV R^2 = 0.021, eD R^2 = 0.003; G087's registered multivariate LOOCV R^2 = 0.030) -- the proxy signal rides the same faint-end/freeze-depth gradient, it is not a separate axis.  (4) THE DOMAIN, STATED PRECISELY: the law holds at rms 0.140 dex on the FROZEN domain z* > 0 (n = 323: SPARC v_flat > ~90 km/s, ATLAS3D sigma_e > ~65 km/s, GEMS G, X-COP; slope 1.155 +- 0.029), and its scatter rises to 0.225 dex on the never-froze shell (z* < 0: GC + dSph + HI, n = 219) where the equilibrium is still coupled to the CMB thermostat; the deep-UFD end (z* -> -1) is the law's one-sided failure.  The 0.18-dex number is a MIXTURE: a frozen-core line at ~0.13-0.15 dex plus the unfrozen shell; the freeze-epoch is the ordering axis, the channel the carrier, the systematics the noise floor.
